Resolves #20883

Adds a sticky all-day row between the day header and timed grid across `Neo.calendar.view.week.Component` and `Neo.calendar.view.DayComponent`, backed by `Neo.calendar.store.Events#getAllDayRecords`, `Neo.timeline.util.IntervalPacker.pack`, an `"All day"` toggle in `EditEventContainer` that hides start/end time fields when checked, calendar CSS/theme styling, and sample all-day events in `examples/calendar/basic/teamWeek.mjs`.

Related: #19140 · #20876 · #20693

Evidence: L3 (local Playwright unit suite on `calendar/` + `vdom/Calendar`, 4 calendar E2E specs, theme build + repo baseline guards, and `1440×900` before/after screenshots across Week and Day views) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-6 covered by Playwright unit specs; AC-7 visually verified on both views). Residual: none.

Change class: capability (`feat`). agent-preflight: not hosted here; pre-commit guards and `check-file-sizes` ran locally.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/calendar/EventsStore.spec.mjs` (`Neo.calendar.store.Events#getAllDayRecords` tests overlapping single-day/multi-day/boundary records sorted ascending while excluding timed and out-of-range events; `getDayRecords` kept untouched with all 5 pinned assertions passing) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/calendar/WeekView.spec.mjs` (`renders a single-day all-day event in the all-day row of both week and day views, and omits it from the time grid`), plus `1440×900` Week and Day screenshots below |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/calendar/WeekView.spec.mjs` (`all-day row stays out of the DOM when no all-day event overlaps the rendered range` asserts `removeDom: true`; overlapping bars stack across 2 lanes and expand lane height) |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/calendar/WeekView.spec.mjs` (`keeps all-day bars aligned with their day columns after scrolling horizontally in both directions` exercises `onWheel` right and left) |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/calendar/WeekView.spec.mjs` (`EditEventContainer sets and clears allDay with time field visibility and the week view moves the event`) |
| AC-6 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/calendar/WeekView.spec.mjs` covers empty, single-day, 3-day, and 2-lane overlapping all-day bars |
| AC-7 | outside-CI: `1440×900` Week and Day before/after frames of `examples/calendar/basic` and two blinded cold-look reads below |

## Deltas from ticket
- Uses `Neo.timeline.util.IntervalPacker.pack` (already merged via `#20876`) instead of a local lane packer.
- Adds the single-day (`Release freeze`, Thu) and 3-day (`Architecture summit`, Tue–Thu) all-day entries in `examples/calendar/basic/teamWeek.mjs`, which replaced `examples/calendar/basic/data/events.json` in `#21362`.
- Gives `.neo-allday-event > .neo-event-title` sticky left positioning (`calc(50px + .4em)`) and adds `.5em` top padding to `.neo-c-w-column-timeaxis-container` below `.neo-allday-row` so multi-day bars starting in a left buffer column remain labelled in Day view and `12 AM` never clips.

### Cold look
Two cold readers without session context graded the unlabelled `1440×900` Week + Day frame pairs from 1 to 10 in swapped order:

| State | Reader A (`before` first) | Reader B (`after` first) |
|---|---|---|
| Before (`origin/dev`) | 7 | 7 |
| After (all-day row) | 6 | 7 |

Weakest points named verbatim:
- **Reader A:** on the `after` pair, pushing the default `12:00 AM`-anchored timeline down by the all-day row slices the `04:00 PM Incident review` block horizontally at the `900 px` viewport bottom edge (while `12 AM–9 AM` remain empty); on `before`, 30-minute blue events omit `AM`/`PM`.
- **Reader B:** both pairs open scrolled to `12 AM` leaving half the grid empty overhead; the extra all-day strip exacerbates `04:00 PM` bottom-edge clipping in `after`.

*(Kept `examples/calendar/basic`'s existing `startTime` untouched so `#20883` stays strictly scoped to the all-day row rather than changing example viewport hours alongside it.)*

## Addressed Review Feedback

**Completion gate:** Required Actions from review `PRR_kwDODSospM8AAAABY8reNA` (head `792403957a`), addressed at `a63b91a152`:

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]` RA-1: opening the editor on a second all-day bar loses that event** — Nice catch! Three mechanisms interacted when double-clicking a second bar while `EditEventContainer` was open: (1) `EditEventContainer#afterSetRecord` delegated to `FormContainer#reset`, which ran asynchronously after `VdomLifecycle#initVnode` snapshotted the VDOM tree and reset omitted fields to `null`, overwriting `CheckBox#value` (`true -> null`) and firing `onAllDayFieldChange` (`summit.allDay = false`); (2) click 1's 100ms `onFocusLeave` timer resolved ~60ms after `dblclick` and unmounted the newly opened editor; and (3) `week/Component#onEventDoubleClick` re-ran `initVnode(true)` without unmounting first. Replaced with synchronous `EditEventContainer#syncRecordFields` guarded by `#isSyncingRecord`, generation-checked `#focusLeaveGeneration` in `onFocusLeave`, and clean `unmount()` + `_hidden: false` reset in `week/Component#onEventDoubleClick` (`a63b91a152`), pinned by unit and real-browser E2E regressions in `test/playwright/unit/calendar/WeekView.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/CalendarWeekViewSwitch.spec.mjs`.

**Non-blocking notes:**
- Documented inclusive `yyyy-mm-dd` `endDate` comparison semantics on `Events#getAllDayRecords` JSDoc (`a63b91a152`).
- Kept the `--neo-allday-lane-height` CSS custom-property extraction out of this bugfix commit to keep the diff surgical; good candidate alongside the multi-day timed-event guard noted on #20883.

All Required Actions are discharged against `PRR_kwDODSospM8AAAABY8reNA` at `a63b91a152`.
